tests.title: Status List Details and Order links open the enrolment and its order
tests.goal: Staff can open an enrolment and its order from Courses & Enrolment > Status List.

steps.text: Go back and click Order on the same row

expected.text: Details opens the enrolment (session, learner, status)
Order opens the linked order detail

checks.label: Details opens the enrolment (session, learner, status)
Order opens the linked order detail

notes: Details (on the word) -> Member Details page for MEMy001164526 with enrolment 388 (QA Course Retest, 2026-10-31 15:00-16:00, Sat Horse Class, Complete, Attend button). Order -> orders/detail?id=11005. Note for automation: click the link text (getClientRects), not the centre of the <a> box.
